attempts.span: In a reentrancy attack, an external contract calls back into the caller before the initial invocation completes.

attempts.span: Using a reentrancy lock, such as OpenZeppelin ReentrancyGuard, mitigates recursive call attacks by preventing reentrant execution of protected functions.

attempts.span: Unchecked low-level call failures can cause unexpected behavior if execution continues without checks. Review your contract's low-level call sites and verify their return values to handle failures correctly.
